exercises.q: Did you take out the rubbish?
exercises.why: **вынес** — вы́нести (perfective): to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove; to transfer; to get, to acquire; to submit. Wiktionary: вы́- + нести́.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **перенёс** — перенести́ (perfective): to transfer, to carry, to transport; (word) to carry over to the next line; to postpone, to put off; to extend. Wiktionary: пере- + нести́.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **перенесли** — перенести́ (perfective): to transfer, to carry, to transport; (word) to carry over to the next line; to postpone, to put off; to extend. Wiktionary: пере- + нести́.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **нёсся** — нести́сь (imperfective): to hurtle, to dash, to race, to tear, to scurry (to move rapidly, violently, or without control); to come, (sound) to reach one's ears, to be heard; to lay eggs. Wiktionary: нести́ + -сь.

exercises.q: The clouds scudded across the sky.
exercises.why: **неслись** — нести́сь (imperfective): to hurtle, to dash, to race, to tear, to scurry (to move rapidly, violently, or without control); to come, (sound) to reach one's ears, to be heard; to lay eggs. Wiktionary: нести́ + -сь.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove
to transfer, to carry, to transport
to hurtle, to dash, to race, to tear, to scurry (to move rapidly, violently, or without control)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́нести — to carry out, to take out, to bring out, to remove; перенести́ — to transfer, to carry, to transport; нести́сь — to hurtle, to dash, to race, to tear, to scurry (to move rapidly, violently, or without control); относи́тельно — relatively (proportionally).
**Унеси** — унести́ (perfective): to take away, to take off, to carry (away); (figuratively) to take (a life), to claim (a life). Wiktionary: у- + нести́.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Good leather will wear for years.
exercises.why: **носиться** — носи́ться (imperfective): to rush, to rush around, to run/drive around (on a high speed); to float around, to fly around; (colloquial) to fuss over, to pay too much attention to, to be obsessed with (an idea); (of smells, sounds, etc.) to spread. Wiktionary: носи́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: That foul odor is coming from the river.
exercises.why: **доносится** — доноси́ться (imperfective): to get / be worn out (of clothes, shoes); to reach one's ears, to be heard; to be carried by the wind. Wiktionary: доноси́ть + -ся.
